<summary>📝 Walkthrough</summary>

## Walkthrough

All `go mod download` invocations in the main `Dockerfile`, three experimental/kueueviz `Dockerfile`s, and two `Makefile` targets are wrapped with `hack/testing/retry.sh` (7 attempts, 2s delay, exponential backoff, streamed output). The kueueviz backend `Dockerfile` also narrows its copied paths to backend-only files, and its `Makefile` build target switches the Docker build context to the repo root.

## Changes

**Retry-wrapped `go mod download` and kueueviz build context fix**

| Layer / File(s) | Summary |
|---|---|
| **Makefile retry wrappers** <br> `Makefile`, `Makefile-test.mk` | `gomod-download`, `gomod-download-tools`, and `ginkgo-top` targets now invoke `go mod download` through `$(NETWORK_INSTALL_RETRY)` with `--attempts 7 --delay 2 --exponential --stream`. |
| **Dockerfile retry wrappers (main and experimental)** <br> `Dockerfile`, `cmd/experimental/kueue-populator/Dockerfile`, `cmd/experimental/kueue-priority-booster/Dockerfile` | Direct `RUN go mod download` steps replaced with `RUN --mount=type=bind` steps that bind-mount `hack/testing/retry.sh` and invoke it with the same retry parameters. |
| **kueueviz backend Dockerfile and build context** <br> `cmd/kueueviz/backend/Dockerfile`, `Makefile` | Dockerfile copies only `cmd/kueueviz/backend/go.mod`/`go.sum`, wraps `go mod download` with retry, and copies only `cmd/kueueviz/backend/` as source. The `kueueviz-image-build` Makefile target switches the Docker build context argument from `./cmd/kueueviz/backend` to `.` to allow bind-mounting `hack/testing/retry.sh` from the repo root. |

## Estimated code review effort

🎯 2 (Simple) | ⏱️ ~10 minutes

## Possibly related PRs

- [kubernetes-sigs/kueue#11992](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/kueue/pull/11992): Modifies the underlying `hack/testing/retry.sh` script that this PR invokes for all go mod download steps.
- [kubernetes-sigs/kueue#12122](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/kueue/pull/12122): Applies the same `NETWORK_INSTALL_RETRY` pattern with exponential backoff to `go install`-based tool targets in Make.

> Each module downloaded feels just right.
> With bound-mount scripts and context set right,
